title: aphanes neglecta
intro: Aphanes neglecta, commonly known as the downy saxifrage, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used to aid in digestion, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Aphanes neglecta are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which help in soothing sore throats and relieving coughs. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
